description: ANALYTICS: list the recent feed for a connected account — the posts on that platform, optionally with engagement metrics (likes, comments, views, etc.). Use this to pull performance data for a given account.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (pagination offset).

social_account_id.description: The connected social account id to read the feed of.

name: list_account_feeds
